mapper.sql: select request_id, user_id, user_name, system_code, feature_code, feature_name, original_level, request_level, request_reason, status, is_temp, request_time, approve_by, approve_time, approve_note, use_time, rollback_time, create_time, update_time from permission_request
mapper.select: where status = '1' and is_temp = 1 and approve_time < #{beforeTime} order by approve_time asc
mapper.insert: insert into permission_request ( user_id, user_name, system_code, feature_code, feature_name, original_level, request_level, request_reason, status, is_temp, request_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{userName}, #{systemCode}, #{featureCode}, #{featureName}, #{originalLevel}, #{requestLevel}, #{requestReason}, #{status}, #{isTemp}, #{requestTime}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update permission_request set status = '1', approve_by = #{approveBy}, approve_time = now(), approve_note = #{approveNote}, update_time = now() where request_id = #{requestId}
update permission_request set status = '2', approve_by = #{approveBy}, approve_time = now(), approve_note = #{approveNote}, update_time = now() where request_id = #{requestId}
update permission_request set status = '3', rollback_time = now(), update_time = now() where request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} and status = '1' and is_temp = 1 order by approve_time desc, request_id desc limit 1
